title: PORTABOOM QR morph recipe
how_to_read: BUILD nodes are how the assets were made (once, off the phone). RUNTIME nodes are what plays on the phone, in order. Each version is a path through the shared RUNTIME nodes plus its own. Every code reference is a GitHub link pinned to the commit the line numbers were read from. Keys are paths in morph-config.json (morph3 and later only).

morph1.label: morph1 - the photo unit hinges up
morph1.summary: The first cut. The QR still shows a rendered PB4000 lying on its back inside the code. After one scan sweep the real 3D unit hinges upright on its back edge while the QR modules ripple, the camera drops to eye level, then green, amber, red, boom down, DEST.

steps.note: Still is portaboom-morph-qr.png: a version-10 QR (encodeTipMatrix) with the rendered unit lying on it; MORPH_MASK marks the 421 cells it covers.
Holds MORPH1_FLAT_MIN_S (1.4 s) after boot instead of scan.auto_start_delay_s.
Single 0.8 s sweep (MORPH1_SWEEP_S, morph1ScanFx); buzz 18-40-28 ms at the start of the scan.
End framing constants: MORPH1_END_UNIT_H 0.66, MORPH1_END_LENS_Y 0.38 (kept within 0.35-0.42), MORPH1_END_LEFT_MARGIN 0.045. No glide.
Hard-coded colours MORPH1_SKY_TOP / HORIZON / TILE_END / GROUND in app.js.
Hard-coded: green 0.5 s, amber 1.0 s, red hold 0.5 s (SHOWTIME_* in app.js).
Hard-coded: SHOWTIME_LOWER_S 1.0 s; no wider boom-down frame.
Hard-coded SHOWTIME_LEAVE_S 0.4 s; DEST from ?dest= or the default product page (no config file).

morph2.label: morph2 - modules fly into the unit (site root)
morph2.summary: The default the printed QR opens. The unit is drawn in QR modules (no photo). After a double scan with finder lock the drawn modules lift off, fly and build a voxel PB4000, the real GLB resolves inside the cubes, then the light and boom cycle and DEST. Its timings are hard-coded constants in app.js; morph-config.json does not change it.

steps.note: Holds MORPH1_AUTO_DELAY_S = 0.8 s (constant, not from config).
MORPH2_SCAN_S = 1.8 s and 2 passes, constants in app.js.
Hard-coded wave in morph2Frame (no lift.* settings); print fade MORPH2_FLAT_FADE_S [0.05, 0.8].
Same matching as morph3 but the timings are literals inside morph2Assign (no flight.* settings, no row-by-row light head).
MORPH2_TARGET_VOXELS = 1100; no floor ripple ring.
Plain shrink from the base up (MORPH2_REVEAL_S [3.3, 4.2], end 4.4 s); no shimmer, ring or lens flash.
Tilt MORPH2_TILT_S [0.05, 3.55] with curve 0.72; framing MORPH1_END_* constants; no glide, no push-in.
Hard-coded colours in app.js.

morph3.label: morph3 - full-screen QR, shimmer, glide
morph3.summary: morph2 made editable: every timing, camera and colour comes from morph-config.json. Adds the QR growing to fill the screen, the shimmer light-wave resolve with a glowing ring and lens flash, a slow camera glide round the unit, and a wider frame when the boom comes down. Every later version is a copy of this file plus its own code.

nodes.label: Art bake: GLB to module drawing
nodes.purpose: Render the real PB4000 model lying on its back, top-down and orthographic, then quantise it to QR-module letters (H housing, R/A/G lenses, O cabinet, K wheels, r/W boom stripes, S STOP...). The result is the frozen grid in morph2-art-grid.js. morph1 instead bakes a mask of the QR cells covered by the rendered unit (morph-mask.js).
change: To redraw the unit in the QR (different pose, bigger or smaller drawing): re-run the art bake and regenerate morph2-art-grid.js; never hand-edit it (it says so at the top).
Bigger drawing means more art cells to hide; error-correction H recovers up to ~30% so keep the art share near the current ~25-30%, and the decode check (next step) must still pass.
nodes.versions_note: all except morph1 use MORPH2_GRID; morph1 uses MORPH_MASK

nodes.label: QR encode: URL + art into one code
nodes.purpose: Encode the tip URL at error correction H, version 13 (69x69), pick mask 6, place the art at row 11 / col 8 with a one-module light halo, keep finder/timing/alignment/format cells as real QR. Writes the print still (PNG + SVG).
change: To change where the printed QR sends people: the URL is the --url argument of make-morph2-qr.mjs (default https://portaboom-qr.vercel.app/?v=morph2). The runtime draws its frame 0 from './?v=morph2' (MORPH1_TIP_URL), so if you print a different URL the page's frame 0 must be updated to match or frame 0 will not equal the still.
Every version (morph3, road, minions...) draws this same morph2 code on frame 0; the ?v= in the link only picks which animation runs.
Art colours for the print are ART_COLORS in morph2-art.js (cabinet orange #F28C28, lenses, boom red).
nodes.versions_note: morph2 and every later version; morph1 uses encodeTipMatrix (qr-url.js) and portaboom-morph-qr.png

nodes.label: Decode check (gate)
nodes.purpose: Prove the art QR still scans: jsQR at native size and 1176 down to 200 px, then zxing-cpp and OpenCV at 1176 down to 240 px. Fails the build if any of the first 12 sizes misses. Receipt: morph2-qr-verify.json.
change: If you enlarge the drawing or change colours and this fails, shrink the art or pick dark/light colours so art cells agree with the data (artMismatch goes down).

nodes.label: Frame-0 match (gate)
nodes.purpose: The page's first WebGL frame must be the still, cell for cell: morph2Init builds one floor instance per drawn module from the same encodeMorph2 output and morph2Flat lays them flat exactly where the still has them; then morph1HandOver removes the HTML still. A headless check screenshots frame 0, compares every module colour to the still and decodes it.
change: Anything that changes frame 0 (QR size on screen, colours, art) must change the still too, or people see a jump when the canvas takes over.

nodes.label: Make the version file
nodes.purpose: Each version is a full copy of a parent app file plus its own code: app3.js is app.js + config + morph3; road, minions, night, blueprint, rain copy app3.js; domino copies app-minions.js; domino2 copies app-domino.js; drone copies app-road.js. night/blueprint/rain were generated by a script that inserts blocks/<mode>.js before the morph2 section, adds the per-version base override and wraps morph1Tick so the mode's tick runs after the shared morph tick.
change: A fix to a shared step (scan, flight, resolve, camera, light cycle) in app3.js does NOT reach the other versions: each app-<v>.js has its own copy. Make the same change in every app file that has that function (the recipe viewer lists them per version).

nodes.label: Publish (Vercel)
nodes.purpose: Commit to main; Vercel (linked to the private repo, auto-deploys on push) serves https://portaboom-qr.vercel.app/. Every asset URL carries a ?b=<hash> cache-buster so phones get the new file, then the live URLs are checked for HTTP 200.
change: When you change an app file, bump its ?b= value in index.html, or phones may keep the old copy.

nodes.label: Boot: pick version, load settings
nodes.purpose: index.html reads ?v=, shows the right still instantly, hides the Tap to scan button unless ?test=1, and loads the version's app file. The app loads morph-config.json (morph3+) and, for night/blueprint/rain, applies that version's 'base' overrides to the shared settings.
change: ?v=<name> picks the version; ?test=1 brings back the Tap to scan button; ?dest=<url> overrides where it ends; ?config=<url> loads another settings file.

nodes.label: Frame 0: the still, then the canvas takes over
nodes.purpose: The HTML still (portaboom-morph2-qr.png) paints first. When WebGL has drawn the identical QR from the same encoder, the still is removed so only one surface is ever on screen. The GLB loads behind it; morph2Prepare samples the unit into voxels and decides which module flies where.
change: QR size on screen at frame 0 is MORPH1_SCAN_FRAC (90% of width, a constant). Change it and the still's CSS (--m1q in index.html) together.

overrides.morph2: Holds MORPH1_AUTO_DELAY_S = 0.8 s (constant, not from config).

nodes.label: Scan sweep + finder lock + buzz
nodes.purpose: Orange focus brackets, a scan line sweeping down and up over the code, then the three finder squares lock with a pulse and the phone buzzes (16-45-26 ms) at 80% of the scan. morph1 uses a single 0.8 s sweep with the buzz at the tap.
change: Longer or shorter scan: scan.duration_s (min 0.3 s). More sweeps: scan.passes (1-6). The lock pulse always sits at 78-92% of the scan.

overrides.morph1: Single 0.8 s sweep (MORPH1_SWEEP_S, morph1ScanFx); buzz 18-40-28 ms at the start of the scan.
overrides.morph2: MORPH2_SCAN_S = 1.8 s and 2 passes, constants in app.js.

nodes.label: QR grows to fill the screen
nodes.purpose: Top-down zoom from the framed QR to a full-screen code; random filler modules pop in outward from the code's edges so the portrait screen is covered. The morph clock (T = 0) starts after this.
change: Slower zoom to full screen: fill.duration_s. Snappier filler pop: lower fill.pop_s. Everything after it shifts by the same amount.

nodes.label: Lift wave: modules lift off the page
nodes.purpose: A wave runs out from the centre through the floor modules: each tile humps up, stretches and tips away from the centre. The flat print look fades into lit 3D cubes over lift.print_fade_s.
change: Higher wave: lift.height_cells. Wave reaches the edges sooner: lower lift.spread_s. Flatter, calmer tiles: lower lift.tilt.

overrides.morph2: Hard-coded wave in morph2Frame (no lift.* settings); print fade MORPH2_FLAT_FADE_S [0.05, 0.8].
overrides.domino: Modules marked for toppling skip the lift wave (dominoTile); the rest lift as morph3, 1.7 s later.
overrides.domino2: Modules marked for toppling skip the lift wave (dominoTile); the rest lift as morph3, 1.7 s later.

nodes.label: Flight: drawn modules fly to the unit
nodes.purpose: morph2Assign matches every voxel of the 3D unit to the art module of the same part at the same relative spot (boom to boom, lenses to lenses, cabinet to cabinet); spare data modules make up the rest; leftover art melts in. Each flyer follows a cubic Bezier with an arc and spin, shrinks to voxel size and changes from QR navy to the unit's colour half-way. Boom builds as a line base-first, the light head row by row bottom-up, the body with a sideways sweep.
change: A part arrives earlier or later: flight.<part>.start_s. Taller arcs: .arc. More tumbling: .spin. Cubes take the unit's colours earlier: lower flight.recolour_from.

overrides.morph2: Same matching as morph3 but the timings are literals inside morph2Assign (no flight.* settings, no row-by-row light head).
overrides.night: Same flight; nightFly redraws the cubes unlit and glowing.
overrides.domino2: Starts domino.delay_s (1.7 s) later (domino2 overlays domino).

nodes.label: Voxel PORTABOOM assembles
nodes.purpose: The standing unit's surface is sampled (60,000 area-weighted points), binned into about 1,100 cubes with hidden inner cubes dropped, coloured by part (lens and boom-stripe colours from settings). As the base completes, a faint ring ripples through the floor; vacated cells refill as plain QR navy.
change: Chunkier or finer cubes: assembly.voxel_count (300-1500; fewer = bigger cubes). colours.lens_* and boom_* colour the cubes only, not the real model.

overrides.rain: The voxel targets come from morph2Voxels / morph2Assign as usual; rainFly moves the cubes instead of the Bezier flight.

nodes.label: Blocks turn into the real unit
nodes.purpose: At resolve.start_s the real GLB switches on inside the voxel shell. In 'shimmer' style a light band climbs the unit: each cube flares, flips on its axis and shrinks into the surface; a glowing ring sized to the unit's cross-section rides the band; lens glow, halos, decal and STOP face fade in with it and the lenses flash as the band passes them. 'shrink' style just shrinks the cubes.
change: Real unit appears later: resolve.start_s. Slower wave: resolve.duration_s. No ring: resolve.sweep_ring 0. Plain version: resolve.style 'shrink'.

overrides.morph2: Plain shrink from the base up (MORPH2_REVEAL_S [3.3, 4.2], end 4.4 s); no shimmer, ring or lens flash.
overrides.rain: rain.base moves resolve.start_s to 4.0 and morph_end_s to 5.5 so the stack finishes first.

nodes.label: Camera: top-down to eye level, glide, framing
nodes.purpose: One perspective camera goes from a near-orthographic top-down view to eye level at the lens height (zero pitch), framed with an off-axis lens shift (never by tilting): the unit fills camera.unit_height of the screen, the lens stack sits at lens_y, the leftmost part at left_margin so the boom has the rest of the width. morph3 adds a glide that ends the rise 18 degrees round the unit and eases back square-on, and a slight push-in during the resolve.
change: Bigger unit on screen: camera.unit_height. Lights higher or lower: camera.lens_y. More boom in shot: lower camera.left_margin. No orbit: camera.glide_yaw_deg 0. Faster drop to eye level: lower camera.tilt_end_s.

overrides.morph1: End framing constants: MORPH1_END_UNIT_H 0.66, MORPH1_END_LENS_Y 0.38 (kept within 0.35-0.42), MORPH1_END_LEFT_MARGIN 0.045. No glide.
overrides.morph2: Tilt MORPH2_TILT_S [0.05, 3.55] with curve 0.72; framing MORPH1_END_* constants; no glide, no push-in.
overrides.blueprint: blueprint.base: camera.tilt_start_s 0.7 (the camera waits while the sheet draws).
overrides.domino: The rise camera is dominoCamera (aisle swoop and dolly), not the morph3 tilt; end framing still morph1DoorPose; glide_yaw_deg = domino.glide_yaw_deg (0).
overrides.domino2: The rise camera is dominoCamera, not the morph3 tilt; end framing still morph1DoorPose.
overrides.drone: Only the end framing (morph1DoorPose) is used: the tilt and glide are replaced by the drone pull-up and swoop; glide_yaw_deg forced to 0.

nodes.label: Sky, horizon, ground and floor colours
nodes.purpose: The cream page blends into a sky gradient, horizon at eye level and a ground plane as the camera comes down; the QR floor calms to the end tile colour.
change: Change the end backdrop: colours.sky_top / horizon / ground; the QR tiles' end colour: colours.floor.

overrides.morph1: Hard-coded colours MORPH1_SKY_TOP / HORIZON / TILE_END / GROUND in app.js.
overrides.road: Sky and horizon blend to road.colours.sky_top / horizon as the road builds; the studio ground hides once the road covers it.
overrides.night: nightEnv blends sky, paper, ground and fog to night.colours.* over night.fade_s.
overrides.blueprint: bpEnv turns the cream page, sky and ground blueprint blue (blueprint.colours.*).

nodes.label: Light cycle: green, amber, red
nodes.purpose: After the hold (and the glide in morph3) showtime starts: green, then amber, then red hold, with the lens materials, halos and lamp lights switched by setSignalAspect.
change: Longer green: lights.green_s; amber: lights.amber_s; pause on red before the boom moves: lights.red_hold_s.

overrides.morph1: Hard-coded: green 0.5 s, amber 1.0 s, red hold 0.5 s (SHOWTIME_* in app.js).
overrides.morph2: Hard-coded: green 0.5 s, amber 1.0 s, red hold 0.5 s.
overrides.road: road.green_s / amber_s / red_hold_s replace lights.* (green 2.4 s so the queue can clear).
overrides.drone: Uses road.green_s / amber_s / red_hold_s (drone is built on the road file).

nodes.label: Boom comes down
nodes.purpose: The boom lowers with a smoothstep over boom.lower_s while red. In morph3+ the camera eases back to a slightly wider frame (unit_height_boom_down) so the lowered arm and STOP disc land in shot.
change: Slower boom: boom.lower_s. More of the lowered boom in frame: lower camera.unit_height_boom_down.

overrides.morph1: Hard-coded: SHOWTIME_LOWER_S 1.0 s; no wider boom-down frame.
overrides.morph2: Hard-coded 1.0 s; no wider boom-down frame.

nodes.label: Leave to the DEST page
nodes.purpose: A short beat after the boom is fully down, the page opens DEST: ?dest= if given, else morph-config.json dest, else the Traffic Access PB4000 product page.
change: Different landing page for everyone: dest. For one printed link only: add &dest=<url-encoded link>. Longer final hold: boom.leave_after_s.

overrides.morph1: Hard-coded SHOWTIME_LEAVE_S 0.4 s; DEST from ?dest= or the default product page (no config file).
overrides.morph2: Hard-coded 0.4 s beat; DEST from ?dest= or the default product page.

nodes.label: morph1: unit hinges upright
nodes.purpose: The rendered unit lying on its back hinges up on its bottom-back edge over 3.2 s and slides to its standing spot while the QR tiles ripple; the boom arm swings up from 2.5 to 4.1 s (red until up, then green); the camera comes down from top-down to eye level 0.1-3.5 s.
change: All timings are constants in app.js (MORPH1_HINGE_S, MORPH1_ARM_S, MORPH1_TILT_S, MORPH1_RIPPLE_S, MORPH1_WAVE_AMP); edit them there, not in morph-config.json.

nodes.label: road: worksite builds outward
nodes.purpose: From road.build_start_s after the fill, the QR tiles inside a growing radius ripple up and sink into asphalt; first ~9 m round the unit, then the world races out to build_radius. Sky and horizon blend to the road palette. The scene itself (sealed road, kerbs, lane lines, grass, trees, hills, cone taper, A-frame signs, parked work ute with beacon, blob shadows) is procedural, no image files.
change: Road appears sooner: road.build_start_s. Faster spread: road.build_s. Recolour any part: road.colours.*.

overrides.drone: drone-scene.js reveals the worksite cell by cell from above (droneCells) instead of the radius build.

nodes.label: road: haze
nodes.purpose: Fog set relative to the subject so the far road fades into the horizon.
change: Clearer distance: raise road.fog_far.

nodes.label: road: boom down, wait, up before green
nodes.purpose: When showtime starts the boom first lowers (red), waits, and rises, then the light cycle runs. Lower and raise use boom.lower_s unless road.boom_lower_s / road.boom_raise_s are added.
change: Longer wait with the boom down: road.boom_down_wait_s.

nodes.label: road: cars, controllers, light cycle
nodes.purpose: Up to 5 cars approach from the camera side facing the lights, queue at a stop line before the lowered boom (car-following model with a stop line), drive away past the unit on green; up to 3 hi-vis traffic controllers turn their STOP/SLOW bats with the lights. road overrides the light timings and the leave delay.
change: More or fewer cars: road.cars (0-5). Faster departures: road.car_speed / car_accel. Longer green for the queue to clear: road.green_s.

nodes.label: minions: build the mini PORTABOOMs
nodes.purpose: One low-poly PB4000 (cabinet with flashers and label band, wheels, mast, signal head with three lenses, boom with STOP disc) in the hero's proportions measured from the hero's voxels; drawn as instanced meshes (body, arm, lenses). Spots are picked on dark QR modules across the screen-filling code, never on the unit's drawing.
change: More minis: minions.count (30-80). Bigger: minions.size (share of hero height). Closer together: lower spacing_cells.

overrides.minions2: minisCfg() = minions settings with minions2 on top (count 220, size 0.2).

nodes.label: minions: pop up, stand, bob, own cycle
nodes.purpose: Minis pop out of their modules lying on their backs in a wave from the hero, stand up, bob, and run their own green/amber/red and boom cycle out of sync; the ones between the camera and the hero duck back into their modules.
change: Earlier crowd: minions.pop_start_s. Calmer: lower minions.bob. Faster own cycle: lower minions.cycle_s.

nodes.label: minions: line up behind the hero and follow it
nodes.purpose: At line_up_s the minis hop into rows behind the hero, turn to face front and from then on copy the hero's light and boom.
change: More rows: minions.rows. Wider spacing: row_gap / col_gap.

overrides.minions2: In minions2 the crowd does not move into rows: it stays where it is and follows the hero (with a ripple).

nodes.label: minions2: cover the whole floor, keep the hero clear
nodes.purpose: Spots are tried from the horizon to the bottom edge, more spread out with distance, clear of a ring round the hero's feet, the strip the boom lands on, and anything that would cover the hero's head, lenses, cabinet, wheels or legs in the end shot (minis right in front shrink or are dropped).
change: Denser crowd: minions2.count. More room round the hero: minions2.ring / hero_clear. Crowd reaches further back: max_depth / reach_cells.

nodes.label: minions2: crowd follows the hero in a ripple
nodes.purpose: The hero's light and boom are recorded over time; each mini plays them back a little later the further out it stands.
change: Slower ripple: minions2.ripple_s.

nodes.label: night: fade to night, QR becomes city lights
nodes.purpose: The page fades to night; every QR module takes a warm window colour (some bright, a third dark) as flat unlit light, with a blurred glow map laid on the paper. Sky, paper, ground and fog follow a night palette.
change: Faster nightfall: night.fade_s. More dark windows: night.dark_share. Brighter city: night.city_glow.

nodes.label: night: glowing cubes
nodes.purpose: The flying modules are drawn unlit and glowing (QR light colour on the ground, then the unit's colours) with billboard halos following each cube.
change: Stronger cube glow: night.cube_glow.

nodes.label: night: wet road spreads
nodes.purpose: A dark glossy asphalt patch with puddles spreads in front of the resolved unit.
change: Road appears sooner: night.road_start_s. Shinier: lower night.road_roughness.

nodes.label: night: lenses and flashers light the scene
nodes.purpose: Point lights at the lens and the two cabinet flashers wash the scene in the current aspect colour, with coloured streak reflections on the wet road.
change: Stronger colour wash: night.wash. Longer reflections: night.streak_length.

nodes.label: blueprint: QR inverts into a blueprint sheet
nodes.purpose: The cream print inverts to blueprint blue with a faint grid; the sheet carries a side elevation, dimension lines and a title, every number measured from the GLB bounding boxes at load time. Nothing flies: every module stays on the paper.
change: Bigger dimension text: blueprint.label_size. Different blue: blueprint.colours.paper.

nodes.label: blueprint: elevation draws, lifts off as wireframe, stands up
nodes.purpose: The front elevation (the GLB's own feature edges, precomputed into blueprint-edges.bin) draws itself, lifts off the paper as a glowing wireframe and stands up into the unit's place.
change: Slower drawing: blueprint.draw_s. Higher lift: lift_height_cells.

nodes.label: blueprint: real unit scans in part by part
nodes.purpose: Cabinet, head, lenses, boom and wheels each scan in bottom-up behind a glowing ring, with a flash, while the wireframe and the ink fade away.
change: Reorder the parts: change the fill_<part>_s start times. Slower per part: fill_part_s.

nodes.label: rain: shoot up, rain down, bounce, stack
nodes.purpose: After the fill the modules shoot straight up out of frame; orange and navy cubes then fall on hand-rolled ballistic paths (gravity, drift, tumble), hit their exact voxel slot, bounce with damping and snap in; the unit stacks bottom-up. rain shifts the shared resolve and glide later (its 'base' block) so the stack finishes first.
change: Longer downpour: rain.rain_s. Heavier fall: rain.gravity. Bigger bounce: rain.bounce_cells.

nodes.label: rain: dust puff and camera shake on boom drop
nodes.purpose: When the boom lands, a small dust puff comes out round the wheels (or at the tip) and the camera shakes for 0.2 s.
change: No shake: rain.shake 0. Dust at the boom tip: rain.dust_at_tip true.

nodes.label: domino: hero starts later
nodes.purpose: All of the hero's flight, lift, resolve, tilt and glide start domino.delay_s later than morph3 so the dominoes fall and the camera reaches the aisle first; the glide is a straight dolly unless domino.glide_yaw_deg is set.
change: Hero builds sooner: lower domino.delay_s.

nodes.label: domino: QR topples corners to centre
nodes.purpose: Each module tips onto its leading edge and falls one cell towards the middle with a small bounce, in a wave from the corners.
change: Slower wave: domino.topple_spread_s. Bouncier landing: domino.overshoot.

nodes.label: domino: guard of honour flips up
nodes.purpose: Along an aisle from the bottom of the screen to the hero, fallen modules flip up as little PORTABOOMs in straight lines either side (reuses the minions mini model).
change: Wider aisle: domino.aisle_width. More lines each side: lines_per_side (1-4).

nodes.label: domino: camera down into the aisle and along it
nodes.purpose: The camera swoops down behind the bottom edge into the aisle at low height and dollies along it to the hero's end frame.
change: Lower camera: domino.camera_height. Slower trip: domino.dolly_s.

nodes.label: domino: rows salute, boom drop ripples down the rows
nodes.purpose: Each row raises its booms just before the camera passes; at the end the hero's lights and boom drop ripple back down the rows; the hero is kept clear in the end shot.
change: Salute earlier: domino.salute_lead. Slower ripple: domino.ripple_s.

nodes.label: domino2: full-floor crowd instead of rows
nodes.purpose: Spots across the whole visible floor with a lane kept for the camera, a ring round the hero, mixed sizes and slight turns; minis in front of the hero shrink to stay under it. Booms rise in a ripple with jitter as the camera passes; the drop ripples back out.
change: Denser: domino2.count. More size variety: size_mix. Wider camera lane: path_clear.

nodes.label: drone: hero later, glide replaced by the swoop
nodes.purpose: Flight, lift, resolve and tilt start drone.delay_s later; the morph3 glide is replaced by the swoop (glide_start_s/glide_s are taken from drone.swoop_*).
change: Hero assembles sooner: lower drone.delay_s.

nodes.label: drone: rise to a top-down drone view
nodes.purpose: The camera rises straight up from the full-screen code to a hover over the worksite with a wider field of view.
change: Higher hover: drone.height. Shift what is under the drone: centre_x / centre_z.

nodes.label: drone: QR turns into the worksite tile by tile
nodes.purpose: Every QR cell gets a threshold; once progress passes it, the module flips up and away and the worksite (drone-scene.js, a copy of road-scene.js that reveals per cell) shows in its place. Far cells go first; the drawing of the unit goes last as its modules fly into the hero.
change: Slower reveal: drone.transform_s. More random order: drone.random.

nodes.label: drone: one long banked swoop to eye level
nodes.purpose: A single eased Bezier from the hover, round to the side and in low behind the queue, banking gently, landing exactly on road's eye-level end frame.
change: Wider arc: drone.swoop_side (sign picks the side). No bank: drone.bank_deg 0.

dest.what: Where the page goes at the end (a full https link). ?dest= in the link wins over this.

scan.auto_start_delay_s.what: Pause on the still QR before the scan starts itself (0-3 s).

scan.duration_s.what: Length of the whole scan animation; raise for a slower, more deliberate scan.

scan.passes.what: How many times the scan line sweeps (1-6).

fill.duration_s.what: Time for the QR to zoom to full screen; everything after shifts with it.

fill.pop_s.what: How long each filler module takes to pop in.

lift.start_s.what: When the lift wave starts (s after the fill).

lift.spread_s.what: How long the wave takes to travel from the centre to the edge.

lift.duration_s.what: How long one tile stays up.

lift.tilt.what: How far tiles tip away from the centre.

lift.print_fade_s.what: How long the flat print look takes to turn into lit cubes.

flight.boom.start_s.what: boom: when this part's first modules leave.

flight.boom.stagger_dist.what: boom: extra delay for modules further from the centre.

flight.boom.stagger_height.what: boom: extra delay for higher voxels (builds bottom-up).

flight.boom.arc.what: boom: height of the flight arc.

flight.head.start_s.what: head: when this part's first modules leave.

flight.head.stagger_dist.what: head: extra delay for modules further from the centre.

flight.head.stagger_height.what: head: extra delay for higher voxels (builds bottom-up).

flight.head.stagger_across.what: head: spread of the head build across its width.

flight.head.arc.what: head: height of the flight arc.

flight.body.start_s.what: body: when this part's first modules leave.

flight.body.stagger_dist.what: body: extra delay for modules further from the centre.

flight.body.stagger_height.what: body: extra delay for higher voxels (builds bottom-up).

flight.body.arc.what: body: height of the flight arc.

flight.recolour_from.what: Share of the flight (0-1) when cubes start taking the unit's colours.

flight.recolour_over.what: Share of the flight the colour change takes.

assembly.voxel_count.what: Target cube count for the voxel unit (300-1500). Fewer = chunkier cubes.

assembly.floor_ripple.what: Ring through the floor when the base lands (true/false).

assembly.ripple_speed_cells.what: Ring speed in modules per second.

resolve.start_s.what: When the real unit starts to appear.

resolve.duration_s.what: How long the wave takes to climb the unit.

resolve.shimmer_color.what: Colour of the light wave and ring.

resolve.shimmer_band.what: Thickness of the wave (share of the unit height).

resolve.flip_deg.what: How far each cube flips as it goes.

resolve.sweep_ring.what: Strength of the glowing ring (0 = none).

resolve.lens_flash.what: Strength of the lens flash as the wave passes the lights.

resolve.push_in.what: How far the camera pushes in during the resolve (0-0.2).

morph_end_s.what: When the morph phase ends and the hold starts.

camera.tilt_start_s.what: When the camera starts leaving top-down.

camera.tilt_curve.what: Shape of the tilt (lower = leaves top-down sooner).

camera.unit_height.what: Share of screen height the unit fills at the end.

camera.unit_height_boom_down.what: Same, once the boom is down (smaller = more boom in shot).

camera.lens_y.what: Where the lens stack sits, from the top (0-1).

camera.left_margin.what: Gap from the left edge to the unit (share of width).

camera.glide_yaw_deg.what: How far round the unit the glide starts (0 = no orbit).

camera.glide_start_s.what: When the glide back to square-on starts.

camera.glide_hold_s.what: Pause after the glide before green.

boom.leave_after_s.what: Pause after the boom is down before DEST.

road.build_start_s.what: When the road starts building (s after the QR fills the screen).

road.build_s.what: How long the road takes to build out.

road.build_radius.what: How far the world builds out (metres).

road.fog_near.what: Haze starts this far behind the unit.

road.fog_far.what: Haze is full this far behind the unit.

road.red_hold_s.what: Red before the boom drops, in road.

road.leave_after_s.what: Pause after the boom is down before DEST, in road.

road.boom_down_wait_s.what: How long the boom stays down before it rises for green.

minions.spacing_cells.what: Gap between minis in QR modules.

minions.size.what: Mini height as a share of the hero.

minions.pop_start_s.what: When the first minis pop up.

minions.pop_spread_s.what: How long the pop-up wave takes to reach the furthest mini.

minions.stand_up_s.what: When they get up off their backs.

minions.cycle_s.what: Length of each mini's own light and boom cycle.

minions.arm_length.what: Mini boom length (share of the hero's).

minions.duck_s.what: When the minis between the camera and the hero duck away.

minions.line_up_s.what: When they fall into rows behind the hero.

minions.col_gap.what: Gap between minis in a row (hero heights).

minions2.count.what: How many minis try to fit (220).

minions2.size.what: Mini height as a share of the hero.

minions2.pop_spread_s.what: How long the pop-up wave takes.

minions2.ring.what: Clear ring round the hero's feet (hero heights).

minions2.hero_clear.what: Screen margin kept clear round the whole hero.

minions2.depth_grow.what: How much more spread out the far minis are.

minions2.max_depth.what: Furthest a mini can stand (hero heights).

minions2.reach_cells.what: How far past the code the spots are tried (modules).

minions2.ripple_s.what: Delay for the hero's lights and boom to reach the furthest mini.

domino.delay_s.what: How much later than morph3 the hero's flight, resolve and glide run (0-6 s).

domino.topple_spread_s.what: How long the wave takes from the corners to the middle.

domino.topple_s.what: How long one module takes to fall.

domino.row_gap.what: Gap between rows along the aisle.

domino.flip_s.what: How long a fallen module takes to flip up.

domino.stand_delay_s.what: Delay between falling and flipping up.

domino.swoop_start_s.what: When the camera starts down into the aisle.

domino.swoop_s.what: How long the swoop down takes.

domino.dolly_s.what: How long the trip along the aisle takes.

domino.dolly_start.what: Where along the aisle the dolly starts.

domino.camera_height.what: Camera height in the aisle (hero heights).

domino.salute_lead.what: How far ahead of the camera rows raise their booms.

domino.salute_s.what: How fast a row raises its booms.

domino.ripple_s.what: How long the hero's lights and boom drop take to ripple down the rows.

domino.glide_yaw_deg.what: Orbit at the end (0 = straight dolly).

domino.hero_clear.what: Space kept clear round the hero in the end shot.

night.fade_s.what: How long the fade to night takes.

night.city_glow.what: Glow strength of the QR city lights.

night.dark_share.what: Share of modules that stay dark.

night.road_s.what: How long it takes to spread.

night.road_radius.what: Road size in front of the unit.

night.wash.what: Strength of the light cycle's colour wash on the scene.

night.flasher_light.what: Brightness of the cabinet flasher lights.

night.streaks.what: Strength of the reflections on the road.

night.scene_light.what: How much of the day lighting stays.

drone.delay_s.what: How much later than morph3 the hero's flight and resolve run.

drone.transform_start_s.what: When the QR starts turning into the worksite.

drone.transform_s.what: How long the tile-by-tile reveal takes.

drone.tile_flip_s.what: How long one tile flip takes.

drone.random.what: How random the reveal order is (0-1).

drone.swoop_side.what: How far the swoop swings to the side (sign picks the side).

blueprint.invert_start_s.what: When the QR starts inverting to blueprint (s after the fill starts).

blueprint.lift_s.what: How long the lift and stand-up take.

blueprint.fill_cabinet_s.what: When the cabinet starts to scan in.

blueprint.fill_head_s.what: When the head starts to scan in.

blueprint.fill_lenses_s.what: When the lenses starts to scan in.

blueprint.fill_boom_s.what: When the boom starts to scan in.

blueprint.fill_wheels_s.what: When the wheels starts to scan in.

blueprint.fill_part_s.what: How long each part takes to scan in.

blueprint.wire_fill_fade.what: How much the wireframe fades as parts fill.

blueprint.base.camera.tilt_start_s.what: Overrides the shared setting camera.tilt_start_s for this version only.

rain.layer_mix.what: How much the bottom-up order is mixed.

rain.bounce_damping.what: How fast the bounce dies away.

rain.settle_s.what: Time to snap into the slot.

rain.dust_at_tip.what: Puff at the boom tip instead of round the wheels.

rain.base.resolve.start_s.what: Overrides the shared setting resolve.start_s for this version only.

rain.base.morph_end_s.what: Overrides the shared setting morph_end_s for this version only.

rain.base.camera.tilt_end_s.what: Overrides the shared setting camera.tilt_end_s for this version only.

rain.base.camera.glide_start_s.what: Overrides the shared setting camera.glide_start_s for this version only.

domino2.yaw_jitter.what: How much each mini is turned its own way.

domino2.reach_x.what: How far out to the sides (hero heights).

domino2.reach_back.what: How far back towards the horizon.

domino2.depth_grow.what: How much more spread out the far ones are.

domino2.path_clear.what: Width of the lane kept clear for the camera.

domino2.front_min_scale.what: Smallest a mini in front of the hero may shrink before it is left out.

domino2.hero_clear.what: Screen margin kept clear round the hero.

domino2.ripple_spread.what: How far the boom ripple spreads sideways.

domino2.salute_jitter_s.what: Random delay so booms do not rise in lockstep.

domino2.salute_lead.what: How far ahead of the camera booms rise.
